By framing drug interdiction as a military war, the administration normalizes extrajudicial executions of suspected civilians without trial or evidence.

The military confuses physical force (WHAT) with legal justification (WHO). Labeling targets as "terrorists" does not grant the legal right to execute them without trial.

The state runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver, manufacturing a high-seas crisis to justify unilateral military power. By projecting the "narco-terrorist" label onto targets, they evade transparency and legal accountability.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
When you map the gap between protecting citizens and executing suspects without trial, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Unchecked executive violence destroys the rule of law.

The Unavoidable Truth: The US military is killing people on the high seas without presenting evidence of their crimes.
The Unavoidable Lie: These unilateral airstrikes are a legally sound and effective way to stop the flow of fentanyl.
